plugins.photosPermission: Implanr accesses your photo library so you can attach images you already have to a case. For example, you can upload a saved radiograph or intra-oral photograph to the patient's Phase 1 record.
plugins.cameraPermission: Implanr uses the camera to photograph radiographs and clinical images for a patient's case, and to scan the barcode on an implant box to record its lot and serial number. For example, you can photograph a post-operative X-ray and attach it to the case's Phase 2 record.
plugins.microphonePermission: Implanr uses the microphone only while you record a video with the camera, so the video includes sound. For example, when you attach a short clinical video to a case discussion or chat, your spoken explanation of the procedure is recorded with it. No audio is recorded at any other time.
